name: Felsworn: Dual Wield is listed once in the spellbook and off-hand weapons still work (#8789)
contract: #8789 reports Dual Wield twice in the Felsworn spellbook. The live Felsworn baseline holds Dual Wield 674 only:
no Dual Wield skill 118 and no second Dual Wield spell 370094. In the client and server SkillLineAbility,
674's row 778 sits on skill 118 with ClassMask 909, which excludes class 14, while row 67415 rewards 370094 on
skill 118 for classes 12-15, 21, 26 and 29-32. Learning 674 must not hand an Ascension class skill 118 through a
row whose ClassMask excludes it, so 370094 never reaches the server or the client spellbook. Control: Dual Wield
674 itself still lets the Felsworn fight with a one-handed weapon in the off hand.

steps.label: FIXTURE: Dual Wield from the live baseline
SETUP: the Felsworn knows Dual Wield 674
DISCRIMINATING: no Dual Wield skill 118 from a row whose ClassMask excludes the Felsworn
DISCRIMINATING: the server never learns the second Dual Wield 370094
The client is never told about the second Dual Wield 370094
The client's spellbook holds Dual Wield 674 exactly once
Worn Shortsword in the main hand
Worn Dagger in the off hand
CONTROL: the off-hand dagger still deals weapon damage
